descriptionChirho: To render holy or purify morally and spiritually, transforming persons or things into a state of holiness through divine action, including both the active process and its resultative state.
To treat or acknowledge as holy, to reverence — used of hallowing God's name in prayer and of setting apart Christ as Lord in one's heart.
To pursue personal holiness or allow oneself to be made holy, used as an exhortation for an individual to continue in sanctification.
